verdict.rationale: The evidence says LangSmith has an API, but nothing shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path under docs.langchain.com. The llms.txt and markdown docs index are documentation, not machine-readable API specs, and the MCP server is a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
